landing.faqRefundsQ: What changed in how refunds are counted?
landing.faqRefundsA: A refund used to count as lost revenue, and stock recovered from a return was ignored. Now a refund lowers net sales, recovered cost comes off product cost, the payment fee is its own line, and a refund dated after the period end is shown as a separate adjustment.

landing.trustQuote: ChatGPT gives you a story once; Profyn gives you a ledger every month.
landing.trustWhy1: Every rupee comes from a tested engine with 360+ automated tests; the AI only explains the numbers.
landing.trustWhy2: Any AI sentence with a figure the engine did not produce is rejected before you see it.
landing.trustWhy3: Thousands of orders reconcile to channel and product totals, the same way every month.
landing.trustWhy4: Each decision is saved with the numbers it was based on and a 30-day check.
landing.trustPromise1: Stored in India on AWS Mumbai; uploaded files are encrypted at rest and every connection uses HTTPS.
landing.trustPromise2: Your account only: other accounts cannot read your data, and we never sell it.
landing.trustPromise3: The AI sees totals by cause, never your order rows, and it is off for your uploads unless you switch it on.

unit.netRevenueFormula: Net revenue = revenue − refunds (revenue is gross sales after discount)
unit.cm1Formula: CM1 = (net revenue − net product cost) ÷ net revenue, where net product cost = product cost − recovered
unit.cm2Formula: CM2 = (net revenue − net product cost − shipping − payment fees − handling) ÷ net revenue; shipping includes return shipping
unit.cm3Formula: CM3 = (net revenue − net product cost − shipping − payment fees − handling − ads) ÷ net revenue; ads are allocated, not caused
unit.netFormula: Net margin = (operational contribution − fixed costs) ÷ net revenue

aiBadge.ai: AI summary · numbers from the engine

ai.title: Why Profyn, not a chat window
ai.sub: Where AI helps, where it is not allowed to, and the live log that proves it.
ai.quote: ChatGPT gives you a story once; Profyn gives you a ledger every month.
ai.p1Text: Every rupee comes from the same engine on every run, and orders, channels and products add up to the same total. More than {{n}} automated tests guard it, and the public checks run on the reference orders.
ai.p2Text: A {{n}}-order Shopify export was processed end to end, the whole file and not a sample of it.
ai.p3Text: Decisions, assumptions, corrections and their 30-day checks are saved with a date and an owner, so next month starts from what you decided.
ai.p4Text: A refund and its recovery are netted once. Unknown stays unknown, never zero. Refunds dated after the period end are prior-period adjustments, not silent restatements.
ai.p5Text: English, Hindi and Telugu, from import to ledger, leaks, scenario and decision in one place, with a monthly report to share.
ai.p6Text: The AI sees aggregates only: totals, counts and labels. Never order rows, customer names, emails or phone numbers. You can switch it off.
ai.checksLine: Public checks right now: {{passed}} of {{total}} pass.
ai.logSub: Every AI reply is checked against the engine before it is shown: a number the engine did not produce is rejected.
ai.logUnavailable: The guard log is not available on this server yet.
ai.disabled: AI switched off on this server
ai.logNote: Counts since the server started. A rejected reply is replaced by the template text, so the page never shows an unchecked number.
ai.switchSub: Profyn works the same without AI: the explanations use fixed templates instead.
ai.switchAccount: Saved to your account. Off means every explanation uses the template text; the numbers stay the same.
ai.switchGuest: Kept in this browser. Off means every explanation uses the template text; the numbers stay the same.
ai.switchedOff: AI wording is off. Template text only.
ai.defaults: AI wording is off by default for data you upload and on for the synthetic demo.

trust.title: Trust and privacy
trust.sub: The data promise, with what this server reports right now beside each line.
trust.regionHow: Your data is stored in an Indian cloud region.
trust.encPromise: Encrypted at rest and in transit
trust.encHow: HTTPS between your browser and Profyn; the database and file storage are encrypted at rest.
trust.encLocal: This server keeps data in memory only (local run).
trust.ownerHow: Uploads, analyses and decisions belong to your account; other accounts cannot read them. Uploads in the demo go to a shared demo workspace.
trust.aggHow: Totals, counts and labels; never order rows, customer names, emails or phone numbers.
trust.trainHow: Profyn does not train models on your data. AI wording is off by default for uploaded data and on for the synthetic demo.
trust.exportHow: Download everything Profyn holds about you as a file, or delete your account and its data, from your profile.
trust.auditHow: Sign-ins, exports, consent changes and deletions are recorded with a date; you can read your own log.
trust.switchHow: Turn AI wording off; every number stays the same and the explanations use templates.
trust.note: Operational contribution, not statutory profit. The demo uses labelled synthetic data.
